exposure: transfemoral balloon occlusion of abdominal aorta
cohort: 31 patients with placenta increta or percreta
finding: Preoperative transfemoral abdominal aorta balloon occlusion during cesarean section in patients with placenta increta and/or percreta was associated with reduced intraoperative blood loss and enhanced possibility of uterus preservation.
mod_finding: Preoperative transfemoral balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta during cesarean section in women with placenta increta or percreta was found to reduce blood loss and increase the likelihood of uterine preservation.
